chapter: Big Eye Louis and Barnes's own playing
title: Big Eye Louis's swing style and Barnes's favorite clarinetist
summary: Barnes says Big Eye Louis was a swinging improviser who always came back to the tune, and names him his favorite clarinetist.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals
